Definition: of Chaldean origin (H426 with pronominal suffix) my God:--Eloi.
BiblicalUsage: eloḯ is the word for my God. In Mark 15:34, the text says "Eloi."
TheologicalSignificance: In eloḯ I find no hidden theology; it simply means my God.
